B_5R_A_outside_calm_1000.answer: NOT OBSERVED OUTSIDE CALM TODAY, BUT IT IS NOT CALM-SPECIFIC - IT IS UNIVERSAL AND CURRENTLY MASKED
B_5R_A_outside_calm_1000.evidence_level: verified (mechanism read in code + both halves measured on disk)
B_5R_A_outside_calm_1000.mechanism: frozen_frame() returns exactly df[REQUIRED_COLUMNS] = 5 columns for EVERY instrument. IBKRBroker.fetch_bars() lowercases and sorts but never subsets, so the live half carries IBKR's average+barcount for EVERY instrument. splice() compares the column lists, so column_mismatch is guaranteed for any instrument that reaches splice.
B_5R_A_outside_calm_1000.why_stress_did_not_hit_it: _refuse_overlap_disagreement runs at track1_live_source.py:474, one line BEFORE guard.splice at :475. roska4_stress = (MNQ,) only, and MNQ trips the overlap check first, so MNQ never reaches splice. roska4_calm = (MES, MNQ) sorted -> MES first; MES passes the overlap check and reaches splice.

measured_proof.reading: MNQ's last stored bar is a PARTIAL 13:45 bar (its low is too high, i.e. price fell further after the snapshot). MES's file stops one minute earlier at a completed bar, so MES has nothing to disagree about.

B_5R_A_outside_calm_1000.consequence: Repairing the MNQ partial bar (or refreshing the parquet) WITHOUT first landing B-5R-B will turn all 24 Stress slots from row-writing into silent crashes. Order of repair matters.

B_5R_B_makes_slot_silent.detail: observe_live_slot catches ShadowRefused, FreshnessRefused, LiveSourceRefused and NotImplementedError. SpliceRefused subclasses RuntimeError and is in none of them. Observed at 10:00 ET: window_open written, then nothing. LiveSourceRefused IS caught, which is exactly why the Stress slots wrote rows - the two refusals are different exception classes, not different severities.

audit_jobs_ran.detail: 5 audit jobs registered at 09:25:32. TRACK1_AUDIT_ROSKA4_CALM fired 10:10 ET, completed OK in 1s, wrote 1 row. The other four are not yet due (global_nkd 03:05 was already past before scheduler start; stress 12:40; swing 16:05; daily 16:15).

audit_verdict_correct.answer: CORRECT ON WHAT IT SAW, BUT ONE REASON IS A PERMANENT FALSE FAIL
audit_verdict_correct.detail: coverage_unobserved and missing_slot_ids are exactly right. no_timing_records is factually true but structural: run_live_day_track1.py contains ZERO references to slot_telemetry (measured: 0, vs 16 in the legacy run_live_day.py). No Track 1 slot can ever emit a timing row, and track1_shadow_acceptance.py:915-918 sets verdict = AUDIT_FAIL unconditionally when durations is empty. Therefore every Track 1 sleeve audit is pinned to FAIL forever, including a perfect window.

any_order_attempt.detail: no order/placeOrder/send_order/--allow-orders text anywhere in the post-restart scheduler log; confirmation file absent; TRACK1_ORDERS_APPROVED unset; the audit order_gate section reports no order marks; orders_possible=false with B1 open.

any_write_to_book_or_checkpoint.detail: live_positions.track1.json absent; global_index/replay_checkpoint.track1.json absent; the API reports book.present=false and checkpoint.present=false. The only file in the whole track1_runtime tree besides the coverage ledger is the single audit row.

track1_maxhold_1s_cause.answer: NO POSITIONS FILE - no other action
track1_maxhold_1s_cause.detail: run_maxhold_exit.py:108-111 checks pos_path.exists() and returns immediately, BEFORE the E1 PID lock and before any IBKR connect. Corroborated by the legacy twin at the same minute taking 10s because it does have a file.

B-5R-A_column_mismatch.scope: universal across all instruments, currently masked on roska4_stress

B-5R-B_spliceRefused_uncaught.effect: slot silent, no ledger row, no window close

B-5R-D_no_slot_timing_from_track1_entry_.detail: run_live_day_track1.py never imports slot_telemetry, so RAITS_TELEMETRY_DIR (set correctly by monitor/ops.py:197) has no consumer in the Track 1 child. The scheduler parent only writes telemetry on record_skip (mutex/preflight), never on completion. Two independent audit rules turn this into FAIL: no_timing_records (acceptance.py:915) when a sleeve has zero rows, and slot_without_timing (acceptance.py:943) for every slot that DID write a ledger row. Fixing B-5R-A and B-5R-B alone will still leave every audit FAIL.
B-5R-D_no_slot_timing_from_track1_entry_.prediction_to_falsify_this: the 12:40 ET roska4_stress audit will return FAIL with at least slot_could_not_evaluate + no_timing_records, regardless of what the market did.

B-5R-E_stale_parquet_partial_last_bar.status: NEW (distinct from B-5R-A; it is a DATA defect, not a code defect)
B-5R-E_stale_parquet_partial_last_bar.detail: data/cache/futures/NQ_continuous_1m_8y.parquet was last written 2026-08-21 13:46 ET and its final bar, 2026-08-21 13:45, is a partial: stored low 29400.25 vs the completed 29395.75. Every Stress slot today refuses on it. The ES file stops at 13:44 and is clean, which is why MES behaves differently. This is the 13:45 ET append boundary that track1_params.py:37 already names.
B-5R-E_stale_parquet_partial_last_bar.ordering_constraint: must be repaired AFTER B-5R-B, never before.

why: roska4_calm: zero observations; the one slot crashed silently.
roska4_stress: 5 of 24 slots so far, all hard refusals; no slot reached the intraday gate, so nothing about the strategy was exercised.
global_nkd: window passed before the scheduler existed; no slot, no audit.
roska4_swing: not yet due, and configured with provider none.
zero timing rows and zero explanation rows across the whole route, structurally rather than incidentally.

proceed_to_5Q_3.rationale: 5Q-3 is explanation/evidence work, and no slot on any sleeve has reached the explanation writer today. Every explanation-layer change would be unexercised by the live route. B-5R-B is a small, well-scoped change to one except-clause that converts today's silent crash into a named row, and it must land before B-5R-E is repaired or the Stress sleeve goes silent too.

recommended_repair_order: 1. B-5R-B - add SpliceRefused to the except chain in observe_live_slot so a refusal becomes a row.

2. B-5R-A - project the live fetch onto REQUIRED_COLUMNS (the BarProvider protocol docstring at track1_live_source.py:121 already declares this contract; IBKRBarProvider violates its own stated contract, so this is enforcing an existing decision, not making a new one).
3. B-5R-D - wire slot_telemetry into run_live_day_track1.py, or the audit can never pass.
4. B-5R-E - refresh/repair the MNQ parquet partial last bar. Strictly after step 1.
conclusions.operator_action_needed_now: NONE. Nothing is unsafe, nothing is placing orders, and no state file is being written. Every remaining Stress slot today will keep writing an honest refusal row. The decision is a code decision, not an ops decision.
